party.name: Kaelen
inventory: Soot-stained goggles; A half-finished clockwork bird
party.lore: This tinkerer, more at ease with gears than with folk, seeks a mythical power source to quell the volatile nature of their creations. Their journey is marked by the constant hum of clockwork and the clanking of their loyal mechanical wolf.
party.title: The Gear-Driven Guardian
party.stat_justification: The focus on mechanical constructs and combat readiness aligns with the Fighter archetype.

Enemy phase: 👹 Cog-Driven Cultist attacks Kaelen: MISS!
story_memory:
[PROLOGUE] The perpetual twilight of Aethel bled through the Static Mist, painting the sky in sickly, iridescent hues as the groaning symphony of decaying brass and grinding gears echoed through the decaying city.

A sudden, violent shudder sent a cascade of rusted plating raining down from above, forcing Kaelen to shove their loyal mechanical wolf, Cog, forward, its metallic paws skittering on the slick, oil-stained cobblestones as a chunk of metal narrowly missed them.

With a final, desperate heave, Kaelen pushed open the heavy, groaning wooden doors of the Adventurer's Guild, stepping inside to the relative quiet and the faint scent of stale ale and desperation.

sample_dungeon.name: Bounty: The Smuggler's Mine
sample_dungeon.description: A gang of goblin ambushers has taken over an abandoned mine on the outskirts of the city, using it to stash stolen goods. The Guild is offering a bounty for clearing them out and retrieving the stolen cargo.

node_01.name: Mine Entrance
node_01.base_description: You stand before the gaping maw of the Smuggler's Mine. A rusted iron sign, long since defaced by claw marks, once read 'Keldrath Co. — Authorized Personnel Only.' The air is damp and thick with the smell of mud and something older, something rotten. Dripping water echoes in the dark. To your left, a collapsed ore cart lies on its side, its wheels stripped. The only way forward is the Main Shaft, a dark tunnel yawning open straight ahead.
node_01.lore_fragment:
### The Smuggler's Mine
Once a legitimate iron mine operated by the Keldrath Company, the Smuggler's Mine was abandoned a decade ago when the veins ran dry. Rumour has it the company's foreman was found dead at the bottom of Shaft Three under mysterious circumstances. Since then, opportunists have used the tunnels as a black-market waypoint, and something older may have moved in long before the goblins arrived.

node_02.name: Main Shaft
node_02.base_description: The main tunnel is wide enough for three men abreast, the walls reinforced with rotten timber beams that groan underfoot. Ancient torches hang in iron brackets, their oil long since spent. A cold draft flows from deeper in — something breathes in the dark below. The path splits ahead: a rusted iron gate, nearly wrenched off its hinges, blocks access to the Storage Bay to the east. To the north, the tunnel continues toward the sounds of distant voices. The Entrance lies back the way you came.
node_02.lore_fragment:
### The Iron Gate
The gate bears the emblem of a coiled serpent biting its own tail — the same sigil found on three other 'abandoned' mine sites across the kingdom. Whatever the Keldrath Company was really doing here, they wanted certain things very well guarded.

node_03.name: Storage Bay
node_03.base_description: The Storage Bay reeks of stolen goods: sacks of grain, crates of weapons, and barrels stamped with Guild insignia that was clearly meant for legitimate merchants. Sloppy handwriting on a wall details crude inventory tallies in what you recognize as Goblin script. Hooks on the wall hold rope, torches, and a set of lockpicks that someone dropped in a hurry. The room is quiet now, but recently disturbed. Clawed boot prints lead back toward the Ambush Chamber. The only exit back is through the broken gate.
node_03.lore_fragment:
### The Stolen Cargo
The Guild markings on the barrels confirm it: three of these shipments were reported hijacked on the King's Road over the past month. Someone organized is running this operation — goblins alone are not capable of this level of logistics. There is a handler deeper in the mine.

node_04.name: Ambush Chamber
node_04.base_description: Torches blaze to life along the walls the instant you step through the threshold — a crude tripwire mechanism. The chamber opens into a wide, low-ceilinged cavern. Crates are stacked into impromptu barricades. A screech rips through the air. Goblin Ambushers melt out of the shadows, blades drawn, yellow eyes gleaming with malice. The exit back to the Main Shaft is behind you. A reinforced door at the far end, marked with a crude skull, leads deeper. But first — you will have to fight.
node_04.lore_fragment:
### The Ambushers
These are no ordinary scavengers. The goblins here are disciplined, organized, and equipped with stolen Guild-issue weapons. Someone trained them. Their leader, a scarred brute the others call 'Skrix,' takes orders from something that hasn't shown its face yet.

node_05.name: The Boss's Den
node_05.base_description: The air here is thick with incense and the acrid tang of alchemy. A crude throne made from smashed crates sits at the centre of the room. Mounted on the wall: a detailed map of the King's Road, with red marks at every ambush site. The floor is scorched in a wide circle — dark ritual markings. On the throne, reclining with contemptuous ease, sits the Mine Boss: a towering cultist in patched iron armour, his eyes reflecting the torchlight with an unnatural orange glow. He smiles when he sees you. He knew you were coming.
node_05.lore_fragment:
### The Mechanized Cult Connection
The ritual circle on the floor matches illustrations in a forbidden text recovered last winter by the Ascendants. The Mine Boss is not just a criminal — he is an acolyte of the Mechanized Cult, siphoning resources to fund something far larger than a smuggling ring. The cult's reach extends deeper into the university's core than anyone suspected.

whispering_woods_raid.name: Whispering Woods Raid
whispering_woods_raid.description: A caravan carrying vital supplies for the Iron Vanguard has been ambushed deep within the Whisper Elves' territory. Recover what remains.

node_01.name: Forest Clearing
node_01.base_description: You stand at the edge of a blood-soaked clearing. The remnants of an Iron Vanguard caravan are scattered amongst the ancient trees. Broken wagons, splintered wood, and the chilling silence of death hang heavy in the air. The scent of pine is now mingled with the metallic tang of blood. A narrow, overgrown path leads deeper into the woods.
node_01.lore_fragment:
### The Whisper Elves' Domain
These woods have always been the domain of the Whisper Elves. They are fiercely territorial and possess an intimate knowledge of the forest, using its natural defenses to their advantage. Few dare to trespass, and fewer still return to tell the tale.

node_02.name: Ambush Point
node_02.base_description: The path opens into a denser part of the forest. Twisted roots form natural pitfalls, and the canopy above is so thick that only dappled sunlight pierces through. Crude tripwires are strung between trees, and the shadows seem to writhe with unseen movement. The air is thick with tension, and the rustling of leaves sounds like whispers. The path continues ahead, and a less-traveled trail branches off to the side.
node_02.lore_fragment:
### Goblin Tactics
The Ruin-Born, particularly the goblins, are known for their opportunistic ambushes. They utilize the terrain to their advantage, setting traps and using the element of surprise to overwhelm their prey. This clearing shows signs of their crude, yet effective, methods.

node_03.name: Scavenger's Cache
node_03.base_description: Hidden behind a thicket of thorny bushes, you discover a small, makeshift camp. Rusted weapons, torn scraps of cloth, and gnawed bones litter the ground. A few discarded sacks contain pilfered goods from the caravan – mostly dried rations and some dented metal plating. The air here is rank with the smell of unwashed bodies and stale ale. The only way out is back to the Ambush Point.
node_03.lore_fragment:
### Bandit Scum
While the Whisper Elves are the primary inhabitants of these woods, opportunistic bandits and Ruin-Born often use their territory as a hunting ground. They prey on the weak and the unwary, leaving behind only ruin and despair. These scavengers likely took advantage of the chaos.

node_04.name: The Whispering Grove
node_04.base_description: You enter a clearing dominated by a massive, ancient tree whose branches twist like skeletal fingers towards the sky. Strange, luminescent fungi grow on its bark, casting an eerie glow. The air here is unnaturally still, and a faint, almost imperceptible whispering can be heard, seemingly emanating from the tree itself. At the base of the tree, a figure clad in dark leather and adorned with poisoned darts stands guard. They are clearly not alone in this sacred place.
node_04.lore_fragment:
### The Grove's Secret
This grove is said to be a place of power for the Whisper Elves, where they commune with the spirits of the forest. The presence of bandits here suggests a deeper corruption, or perhaps a desperate alliance. The whispering might be the voices of the forest itself, warning intruders.

node_05.name: The Elven Chieftain's Lair
node_05.base_description: Deep within the grove, you find a hidden alcove carved into the roots of the ancient tree. The air is thick with the scent of exotic herbs and potent poisons. Scattered around are vials, alchemical equipment, and a collection of intricately carved bone totems. Before you stands the Chieftain, a lithe figure with eyes that gleam with ancient malice and a bow strung with what looks like dried sinew. They are the architect of this ambush, and they will defend their territory with deadly precision.
node_05.lore_fragment:
### The Poisoned Arrow
The Whisper Elves are masters of poison, their knowledge passed down through generations. Their arrows can fell the mightiest warriors, and their brews can incapacitate even the most resilient foes. This Chieftain is the embodiment of their deadly art, a true threat to any who dare to disturb their peace.

whispering_gears.name: The Whispering Gears
whispering_gears.description: A section of the lower city's ventilation system has gone silent. Engineers suspect a rogue cult and their disturbing rituals.

node_01.name: Ventilation Access Shaft
node_01.base_description: A cold, metallic shaft descends into darkness. The air is thick with the smell of ozone and decay. Faint grinding sounds echo from below.
node_01.lore_fragment: The Sky-Cities are not built, but grown. Ancient, colossal machines form their foundations, their gears turning with a life of their own. The Static Mist is their lifeblood, and their slow decay is our doom.

node_02.name: The Grinding Chamber
node_02.base_description: Massive, rusted gears dominate this chamber, still turning with a deafening groan. The floor is slick with an oily residue. Strange symbols are etched into the metal.
node_02.lore_fragment: The Whispering Cog believes the machinery is divine. They perform rituals to appease the 'Great Grinder,' hoping to hasten its awakening and usher in a new age of mechanical enlightenment.
node_02.enemy_attack_flavor: Whirls a rusty wrench with cultic fervor.

node_03.name: The Static Conduit
node_03.base_description: A narrow passage where the air crackles with raw energy. Wires hang precariously, sparking intermittently. A large, locked grate blocks further progress.
node_03.lore_fragment: Technomancy is a dangerous art. The Static Mist can grant immense power, but prolonged exposure warps the mind and body, leading to 'Static Sickness' or the dreaded 'Haywiring' of one's very being.
node_03.puzzle_obstacle: A heavy grate secured by a complex, sparking lock. The lock is humming with residual static energy.

node_04.name: The Scavenger's Nest
node_04.base_description: A small alcove filled with discarded parts and crude tools. The stench of unwashed bodies hangs heavy in the air. A hulking figure guards the entrance to the next area.
node_04.lore_fragment: Goblins, once common pests, have adapted to the lower city's decay. They scavenge for anything useful, often falling prey to the cultists or becoming their unwilling servants.
node_04.enemy_attack_flavor: Swings a massive, crudely fashioned hammer.

node_05.name: The Heart of the Machine
node_05.base_description: This vast chamber houses a colossal, pulsating mechanism. The air is thick with the hum of latent power and the chanting of cultists. At the center, a robed figure directs the ritual.
node_05.lore_fragment: The cult believes that by feeding the ancient machinery with energy and sacrifice, they can awaken its true purpose, a purpose that may involve the destruction of the Sky-Cities and the liberation of the surface.
node_05.enemy_attack_flavor: Channels raw static energy through a corrupted cog.
